children: has just completed a death cross on its 2-hour charts, and ADA's short-term price direction is now in the spotlight.

Traders often look for the death cross pattern using the 50-day and 200-day moving averages. Crosses can also happen on intraday charts using a shorter time frame. The significance depends on which averages you are looking at and the bigger market trend.
The MA 50 fell below the MA 200 on the 2-hour chart, completing a death cross. This signal follows Cardano seeing profit-taking in the past week.

Cardano found support following this drop and rallied back to $0.259 before pulling back slightly. At the time of writing, ADA was down 2.74% in the last 24 hours to $0.248 and 0.8% weekly.

The death cross signal alone does not confirm that a deeper decline is coming; the key question is whether ADA confirms the pattern with continued selling or recovers enough to invalidate the short-term bearish setup.

However, moving-average crossovers are lagging indicators of price action and can produce false signals, particularly in choppy or range-bound markets. A pick-up in buying volume or a sustained move back above the pertinent averages could take the edge off the bearish view.
Major resistance is anticipated near $0.29, where price retreated on October 6, 2026, while support is expected at $0.227 and $0.213.
